signals: Elevated CPU utilization metrics, potential increase in response times, possible latency issues, service degradation.
impact: Degraded API performance, potential timeouts for clients, reduced service availability under load, poor user experience.
remediation: Investigate root cause (e.g., inefficient code, sudden traffic surge, resource limits). Scale up/out instances. Optimize application code/queries. Implement rate limiting or load shedding.

signals: Repeated container restarts, unhealthy liveness/readiness probes, application logs indicating startup failures or unhandled exceptions.
impact: Complete service unavailability for the web application, users unable to access the site, potential data loss if stateful.
remediation: Review application logs for errors/exceptions during startup. Check configuration files and environment variables. Rollback recent deployments. Debug application code for fatal errors.

signals: Healthy status, expected resource usage, successful task processing, no error logs, consistent throughput.
